title: Volley Claude Account Usage
description: A supervisor's retained per-account fold of its agents' usage samples and its machines' usage probe readings, published to volley/_system/claude-accounts/<acct>. The rate-limit windows belong to the account, not the agent, so the newest sample wins. See spec section 4.6.12.

account.description: A local account, or <acct>@<host> for a remote host's own login (its agents' samples are never folded into a local account).

plan.description: The plan label Claude Code reports: at sign-in for a registry account, from `claude auth status` of the default profile for `primary`. Absent when it is not known.

email.description: The login's e-mail address: the login's identity as Claude Code's own configuration records it; never a credential. Absent when it is not known.

org.description: The login's organisation name: the login's identity as Claude Code's own configuration records it; never a credential. Absent when it is not known.

five_hour.description: The 5-hour window from the newest sample or usage probe reading that carried one; null when none has.

weekly.description: The weekly window from the newest sample or usage probe reading that carried one; null when none has.

model_weekly.description: Weekly windows scoped to one model family, as the machine that holds the login last read them with its usage probe (the statusLine reports none). Absent until a probe has read one.

probe.description: The newest usage probe attempt for this account's login, a failed one included: the machine that holds the login, how it went (machine.schema.json claude_logins[].state), when, and when it last read. Absent until a probe has reported.

agents.description: Agents whose latest sample is on this account and recent: a session the supervisor does not supervise is forgotten an hour after its last sample (spec section 4.6.12).

sampled_at.description: captured_at of the newest sample, or read_at of the newest usage probe reading, folded in (a probe's attempt while there is neither).

sampled_by.description: The agent that published the newest statusLine sample; absent while only usage probes have reported.
